notes: Fixes for 0.4.2: a cheat with more than one code reported an error after it had gone on (the MiSTer counts codes, not entries; the app now expects the entry's own code count). Suspend points are offered only on cores that have a save state area; on the N64 core, which cannot save states in its current build, the game sheet says so instead of showing Save buttons. Verified through the app on NES, SNES, PSX, GBA, Game Boy, Master System and Lynx.
